adapter_provenance.method: Independent dispositions and dimension rationales copied unchanged; source paths bound to evidence IDs

reliability.rationale: All saved predictions and primary metrics independently reproduce from source-verified inputs, including unfavorable alternatives. Reported positive depth uncertainty is an author-estimated quality quantity, not independently measured depth error. The reference improves original and postfreeze robust controls; the latter comparison is exposed diagnostic evidence, never preselection evidence.

mechanism.rationale: Computational agreement cannot identify a physical or causal mechanism. Reported positive depth uncertainty is an author-estimated quality quantity, not independently measured depth error. The reference improves original and postfreeze robust controls; the latter comparison is exposed diagnostic evidence, never preselection evidence.

novelty.rationale: This review checks computation and information access; targeted literature records are not independent priority adjudication.

significance.rationale: Reusable scoped comparison and preserved falsification evidence. Reported positive depth uncertainty is an author-estimated quality quantity, not independently measured depth error. The reference improves original and postfreeze robust controls; the latter comparison is exposed diagnostic evidence, never preselection evidence.

reproducibility.rationale: Native reconstruction, independent group-weighted metric reduction, frozen replay, row-order invariance and target-poisoning checks passed. Development validation identities were checked against recorded training membership.

impact.rationale: No deployed intervention, operational saving, clinical qualification or independently measured safety benefit is established.

checks: All frozen predictor and metric replay
Undeclared target poisoning and row-order invariance
limitations: Reported positive depth uncertainty is an author-estimated quality quantity, not independently measured depth error. The reference improves original and postfreeze robust controls; the latter comparison is exposed diagnostic evidence, never preselection evidence.
